name: OpenAlex keyword search
description: Searches scholarly works in OpenAlex by keyword and looks up a DOI.
advantages: Open, citable scholarly data; no model cost.
disadvantages: A keyword query given a whole sentence finds little.

name: OpenAlex semantic search
description: Matches the question to titles and abstracts by meaning, using OpenAlex's own embeddings.
advantages: Suits full-sentence questions; we embed nothing.
disadvantages: Rate limited to one request a second; no run is recorded yet.

name: OpenAlex keywords, rule rewrite
description: Cuts the question to a short keyword query by rule, then runs the keyword search.
disadvantages: A fixed rule cannot pick the topic words as well as a model might; no run is recorded yet.

name: OpenAlex keywords, model rewrite
description: Has a cheap model write the keyword query through the model-call seat, then runs the keyword search.
disadvantages: Costs a model call per question; no run is recorded yet.

name: Semantic and web paper search
description: Finds papers by meaning through OpenAlex and adds a web search for what the index lacks.
advantages: Reaches both the scholarly index and the open web for one question.
disadvantages: Two services to reach, and each adds its own delay and limits.

name: Brave Search API
description: Searches the Brave Search API through the generic JSON-API backend; the entry is data.
advantages: Independent index; adding it is one data entry.
disadvantages: Needs a key; no run is recorded yet.

name: Gemini grounding
description: Searches through Gemini's Google Search grounding tool and resolves the redirect links to the real pages.
advantages: Needs only a Gemini key; free up to a daily limit of grounded prompts.
disadvantages: Ties the search to one vendor's model and quota.

name: Provider-native search
description: Wraps any model provider object that exposes web_search(query, model, max_results).
advantages: Reuses a provider the consumer already has.
disadvantages: Quality and shape depend on the provider; a link may arrive unresolved.

name: SearXNG metasearch
description: Searches a self-hosted SearXNG instance by base url.
advantages: Open source and self-hosted, no per-query fee.
disadvantages: Needs an instance to run and keep; no run is recorded yet.

name: Serper Google search
description: Searches the Serper API through the generic JSON-API backend; the entry is data.
disadvantages: Needs a key; no run is recorded yet.

name: Tavily search API
description: Searches the Tavily API through the generic JSON-API backend; the entry is data.
advantages: Built for agent use; one data entry to add.
disadvantages: Needs a key; no run is recorded yet.

name: Web research
description: Snippet-first web search over the chosen search backend, plus a focused page fetch, returned as citable observations.
advantages: Cheap search results first and a page read only when needed.
disadvantages: Finds pages, not papers by meaning; weak on research-paper questions.

name: Categories of tools
description: The record that names the categories of tools carried out today, Web Search, and the place where a person keeps personal data.
advantages: A new integration enters a category as data and is compared on the same cases.
disadvantages: Only Web Search is carried out; other categories are not.
